Hi Alan — thanks for the details and the completed form. Sorry for the friction here.

Short debugging notes / immediate actions:
1) Portal invites can fail on our side if the vendor's mail domain has strict SPF/DKIM or if the corporate MTA marks automated invites as spam. I'm going to open a ticket with Coupa support now and request a whitelist and resend.
2) Temporary workaround: if you can use a non-corporate email (e.g., a gmail alias) for initial verification we can complete the account and then change the primary contact to procurement@northwindlabs.com once it's validated. I know it's not ideal but it's the quickest path.
3) To accept an initial PO we'll need: W-9 (or local tax equivalent), bank details for ACH, and a signed MAA (attached — please review).

Can you confirm if you can provide a personal/vendor-rep email for the initial signup? If not, I'll escalate to Coupa and ask them to reissue from an alternate sending domain.

Connor — looping you in to help with the whitelist request and to run the PO acceptance checklist once the account is live. Marissa — heads up on the pilot timeline.

Best,

Hi Grace / team,

Thanks for the confirmation and for the ticket details. We've investigated the bounce trace and it indicates the recipient's MTA rejected the message due to a strict authentication policy (DMARC policy on northwindlabs.com returning reject). The invite itself is valid on our platform.

What we did: 
- Whitelisted the vendor record for Northwind Labs in our sending system and resent the invite from an alternate sending domain (coupa-notify.com) at 15:18 UTC.
- Created a manual account placeholder for procurement@northwindlabs.com so you can assign the vendor to your Redwood tenant while they finish email verification. The placeholder account will require final identity/ tax verification to be completed by the vendor.

Next steps for vendor:
1) Check procurement@northwindlabs.com inbox (or spam) for the new invite from donotreply@coupa-notify.com.
2) If invite does not arrive, ask their IT to allow coupa-notify.com and ensure SPF/DKIM are passing.
3) Complete identity/tax docs upload in the portal within 48 hours to avoid expiration.

Ticket ID: COU-91247
If you want, we can also trigger a one-time SMS 2FA to the vendor rep on file as a delivery fallback — let us know the mobile number and we can enable that.

Regards,
